header.what: Golden set for the jess router (midas-intel docs/plans/2026-10-21-jess-voice-router.md; founder 2026-10-21). Each case: the sentence (say), a fixed context (ctx: now, time zone and the user's Sidekicks with a summary of their records, as the phone sends them; each Sidekick's agent block is read from sidekicks/<id>/manifest.json at run time), the one tool call the model should make (call: the tool and only the arguments said; every other nullable argument is null, a flag false, and a when has every field filled from the defaults in scripts/eval-jess.mjs), and the expected result (expect).
header.expect: Either {tool, input} (the tool chosen and every input field named must match; title and name are scored apart; input.when is {date, time, repeat} after Midas works it out, or null), or {status: 'repair', sidekick, kind}, or {status: 'not-done', reason}. A not-done case passes whatever the reason; the reason is reported.
header.now: Tuesday 2026-10-20, 10:00 in Los Angeles, in every context.
header.sources: Every sentence was written by hand for Midas on 2026-10-21; none is copied from a dataset.
header.grow: Context grow is home with "grow": true (jess grows the Sidekick, founder 2026-10-21; the flag on): a clear request the Sidekick has no option for expects {status: 'grow', sidekick}; unclear words, questions, snooze and repair requests stay as they are. Added 2026-10-21, phase 7.
